config.hubUrl.description: xDev Hive hub URL, for example `https://hive.example.com`. Leave empty to use `hive.json` or `worker.json` on this machine. Read from user or machine settings only, never from the workspace.
config.binPath.description: Folder holding `hive` and `hive-worker`. Leave empty to search `~/.xdev-hive/bin`, then `PATH`. Read from user or machine settings only, never from the workspace.
config.worker.autoStart.description: Start a worker when VS Code opens and none is running on this machine (the machine must be registered with the hub). The worker stops when the window that owns it closes.
config.mcp.transport.description: How VS Code connects to Hive MCP.
config.mcp.transport.http: Call `{hub}/mcp` over HTTP directly; the header is added when the server starts.
config.mcp.transport.stdio: Run `hive mcp` (needs the hive CLI); the token comes from the keychain.
config.codeLens.enabled.description: Show the "Assign to agent" CodeLens on tasks in `specs/*/tasks.md` and on functions in code files.
config.language.description: Language of xDev Hive UI text.
